name: qingji
description: Qingji: lightweight, self-hosted Markdown notes with offline sync and S3 backups.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @mynote/server" "npm run dev -w @mynote/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mynote/server && npm run build -w @mynote/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mynote/server && npm run test -w @mynote/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mynote/server && npm run typecheck -w @mynote/web
